new_assertions.body: The full quadratic feature space is not the scalar evaluator state. The scalar correction quotient has dimension two on each demanding carrier despite structural interaction dimensions ranging from 37 to 472.
The natural next D_G factorization is affine component contribution plus a two-bit interaction syndrome, not affine contribution plus the entire pair-feature basis.
Both outcome-code bits are separately non-affine on every demanding carrier, so a one-bit correction cannot represent the frozen two-bit outcome gauge without additional nonlinear decoding.
REL_INC contains enough structural information to realize the complete two-bit scalar correction target across all current demanding carriers.
Fresh 3x7 demonstrates that structural quadratic directions may be completely scalar-redundant; structural rank gain must not be conflated with value complexity.
The next discovery pressure is to identify two frozen outcome-independent syndrome formulas and then qualify them on a fresh carrier where affine decoding fails.
